verdict.rationale: Reclaim's Scheduling Links let others book time against "you and your team's availability" across "one, or many, calendars" (reclaim-docs-49), and Smart Meetings find times across all attendees' schedules (reclaim-docs-5). That suggests multi-host availability, but no doc states that a link shows only slots where every required host is free. missing for 10: explicit documentation of a collective/all-hosts-required link mode, required vs optional host settings, configuration details for sales-team use, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
